custom_pid_edit.description:
**{action}: {pid_name}**

Formulas use the integration's canonical notation:
• `B(n)` — unsigned byte at index n
• `B(n, m)` — big-endian unsigned word, bytes n..m inclusive
• `S(n)` / `S(n, m)` — signed equivalents
• `BIT(b, n)` — single bit n of byte b

Operators: `+ - * / // % ** & | ^ ~ << >>`

The formula is validated against a strict whitelist before saving — no attribute access, function calls (other than B/S/BIT), or names are permitted.
custom_pid_edit.title: Add / Edit Custom PID
